Spindle Box Montessori Activity 
The Spindle Box activity helps children learn numbers, counting, quantity, and one-to-one correspondence in a hands-on way. 🧮✨

Children place the correct number of spindles into each numbered compartment, developing:

🔢 Number recognition

🤲 Fine motor skills

🧠 Concentration and logical thinking

🔗 One-to-one correspondence

📊 Understanding of quantity

🌱 Living & Non-Living Things – Segregation Activity
Activity Name: Sort It Out! 🌿🧸
Objective:
To help nursery children identify and segregate living things and non-living things.

Learning Outcome:
✨ Children learned to differentiate between living and non-living things in a fun and interactive way.
✨ They developed observation, identification, and sorting skills.
